description: This file implements an HTTP middleware filter for Kubernetes API server that manages Retry-After responses during shutdown, including logic for exempt paths and user agents.

classes.name: retryAfterParams
classes.description: Struct defining parameters for constructing Retry-After responses, including whether to tear down the connection and the message to send.

methods.name: WithRetryAfter
methods.description: Main function that wraps an HTTP handler to reject requests with a 429 status and Retry-After headers during server shutdown.

methods.name: withRetryAfter
methods.description: Internal helper that creates the actual middleware logic, handling the decision to send Retry-After responses.

methods.name: isRequestExemptFromRetryAfter
methods.description: Determines if a request should be exempt from Retry-After rejection based on user agent or path prefix.

methods.name: isKubeApiserverUserAgent
methods.description: Checks if the request's user agent indicates it originates from the kube-apiserver.

methods.name: hasExemptPathPrefix
methods.description: Checks if the request URL path matches any of the predefined exempt prefixes.
